article.text: EnviroGets is a leading environmental consulting foundation in Saudi Arabia, licensed by the National Center for Environmental Compliance (NCEC) – Category (A), delivering services across the Kingdom.
The company operates ISO-accredited laboratories for water, soil, air quality, and noise monitoring, ensuring accurate results and full compliance with environmental standards.

soilTypes.title: Types of Analyses Performed on Soil Samples
text: Chemical Analysis: Includes the analysis of organic pollutants (BTEX, PAH, TPH), heavy elements, toxic metals, pH levels, organic matter, nutrients, and dissolved salts.
Physical Analysis:Includes the determination of moisture content, bulk and true density, and the percentages of sand, silt, and clay
Biological Analysis: Conducted to examine and assess microorganisms
